zh-CN.headlineFact: 平台、能源、公共卫生与极端天气重排今日风险表
zh-CN.headlineView: 韧性不是口号而是库存、电力、医疗与恢复速度
zh-CN.headlineFull: 平台、能源、公共卫生与极端天气重排今日风险表；韧性不是口号而是库存、电力、医疗与恢复速度
zh-CN.intro: Wildberries仓储遭袭、欧盟AI透明期限与美股油价波动改变经营判断；伊朗和平期限、乌克兰能源设施受损、刚果埃博拉与美国洪灾把系统韧性推到今天中心。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 未来城市的绿色屋顶之下，也要有备份仓库、可靠电网和能快速行动的公共系统。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 叶子会长，风险清单也要每天更新。

en-US.headlineFact: Platforms, energy, public health and severe weather reset today's risk map
en-US.headlineView: resilience now means inventory, power, care and recovery speed
en-US.headlineFull: Platforms, energy, public health and severe weather reset today's risk map; resilience now means inventory, power, care and recovery speed
en-US.intro: Strikes on Wildberries depots, EU AI transparency deadlines and oil-driven market swings reshape operating decisions, while the Iran deadline, Ukraine energy damage, Congo Ebola and US floods put system resilience at the center.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Beneath a future city's green roofs, you still need backup inventory, reliable power and public systems that can move fast.
en-US.doudouQuote: Leaves grow, and the risk list needs a daily refresh.

sources.title: Ukraine takes aim at Russia's economy and morale by attacking online retailer
Congo's fast-moving Ebola outbreak becomes the country's worst with over 2,300 dead

zh-CN.headlineFact: 约20处Wildberries设施遭袭冲击数十万卖家库存
zh-CN.headlineView: 跨境经营者必须重算仓网集中度与货权风险
zh-CN.headlineFull: 约20处Wildberries设施遭袭冲击数十万卖家库存；跨境经营者必须重算仓网集中度与货权风险
zh-CN.intro: 乌克兰无人机近几周持续打击俄罗斯最大电商Wildberries的大型仓库，估计烧毁价值数十亿美元的商品；平台约占俄罗斯一半网购订单，并连接来自中国、土耳其和阿联酋等地的货源。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 把库存集中在一个平台仓里，效率很高，直到地缘风险把单点变成断点。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 多一个仓，不只是多一份运费，也是多一条活路。

en-US.headlineFact: Strikes on about 20 Wildberries sites hit inventory held by hundreds of thousands of sellers
en-US.headlineView: cross-border operators must recalculate warehouse concentration and title risk
en-US.headlineFull: Strikes on about 20 Wildberries sites hit inventory held by hundreds of thousands of sellers; cross-border operators must recalculate warehouse concentration and title risk
en-US.intro: Ukrainian drones have repeatedly hit major depots of Russia's largest online retailer, burning merchandise worth an estimated billions of dollars; Wildberries handles about half of Russian online orders and carries goods sourced from China, Turkey, the UAE and elsewhere.
en-US.xiaziQuote: One platform warehouse is efficient until geopolitical risk turns a single point into a break point.
en-US.doudouQuote: A second warehouse is not just extra freight; it is another route to survive.

sources.title: Ukraine takes aim at Russia's economy and morale by attacking online retailer

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧盟AI透明义务已进入执行期
zh-CN.headlineView: 存量生成式AI距离12月2日标记期限只剩106天
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧盟AI透明义务已进入执行期；存量生成式AI距离12月2日标记期限只剩106天
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟AI法案的部分执法权限与透明义务已于8月2日生效；此前已投放市场的生成式AI系统，可在12月2日前完成机器可读内容标记与检测义务改造。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 透明不是一张免责声明，而是一条贯穿生成、导出、分发和审计的产品链路。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 倒计时不会写代码，团队得自己把它放进版本表。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人工智能 AI。

en-US.headlineFact: EU AI transparency duties are now in their enforcement period
en-US.headlineView: legacy generative AI has 106 days left before the December 2 marking deadline
en-US.headlineFull: EU AI transparency duties are now in their enforcement period; legacy generative AI has 106 days left before the December 2 marking deadline
en-US.intro: Some EU AI Act enforcement powers and transparency duties began on August 2; generative AI systems already on the market have until December 2 to implement machine-readable content marking and detection obligations.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Transparency is not one disclaimer; it is a product chain across generation, export, distribution and audit.
en-US.doudouQuote: A countdown cannot ship code, so put it on the release plan.

sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions
sources.publisher: European Commission AI Act Service Desk

zh-CN.headlineView: 一人公司要把运费、能源与客户购买力拆成三张表
zh-CN.headlineFull: 油价上行令标普500回落0.4%；一人公司要把运费、能源与客户购买力拆成三张表
zh-CN.intro: 标普500周一下跌0.4%，但仍接近历史高位；油价在伊朗协议不确定性下走高，零售商同时面对就业转弱与通胀账单，经营者不能把资产价格等同于真实需求。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 指数接近新高，不代表你的客户有更多可支配现金。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 把油价、运费和转化率分开看，别让一条曲线骗三次。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：一人公司 OPC。

en-US.headlineFact: Rising oil prices pulled the S&P 500 down 0.4%
en-US.headlineView: solo firms should separate freight, energy and customer purchasing power
en-US.headlineFull: Rising oil prices pulled the S&P 500 down 0.4%; solo firms should separate freight, energy and customer purchasing power
en-US.intro: The S&P 500 fell 0.4% Monday while remaining near its record; oil rose amid uncertainty over an Iran deal, as retailers also face weaker employment signals and inflationary bills, making market levels a poor proxy for customer demand.
en-US.xiaziQuote: An index near a record does not mean your customer has more disposable cash.
en-US.doudouQuote: Track oil, freight and conversion separately; one chart should not fool you three times.

sources.title: US stocks edge back from their record as oil prices rise

zh-CN.headlineFact: 伊朗战争永久协议的60天期限到期
zh-CN.headlineView: 霍尔木兹控制与核问题让双方距离比两个月前更远
zh-CN.headlineFull: 伊朗战争永久协议的60天期限到期；霍尔木兹控制与核问题让双方距离比两个月前更远
zh-CN.intro: 6月谅解备忘录设定的60天期限已经到期，但美国与伊朗尚未达成永久停战和核问题协议；霍尔木兹海峡战前承载全球约五分之一的石油和天然气贸易。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 期限可以结束一段等待，却不能替双方交出最难的筹码。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 计时器归零了，谈判桌还没有清零。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：伊朗和平期限。

en-US.headlineFact: The 60-day deadline for a permanent Iran war agreement has expired
en-US.headlineView: Hormuz control and the nuclear dispute leave the sides farther apart
en-US.headlineFull: The 60-day deadline for a permanent Iran war agreement has expired; Hormuz control and the nuclear dispute leave the sides farther apart
en-US.intro: The 60-day deadline set by a June memorandum has expired without a permanent end to the war or a nuclear agreement; before the conflict, the Strait of Hormuz carried about one-fifth of the world's traded oil and gas.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A deadline can end the wait, but it cannot surrender the hardest bargaining chips for either side.
en-US.doudouQuote: The timer hit zero; the negotiating table did not reset.

sources.title: The 60-day deadline for an Iran peace deal is expiring. Here's where things stand

zh-CN.headlineFact: 乌克兰能源设施一周遭13次俄军打击
zh-CN.headlineView: 近300次年度攻击让冬季供应风险提前显形
zh-CN.headlineFull: 乌克兰能源设施一周遭13次俄军打击；近300次年度攻击让冬季供应风险提前显形
zh-CN.intro: 乌克兰国有能源公司称，多个地区设施在一周内遭到13次无人机与导弹打击，设备和生产能力严重受损；今年累计攻击已接近300次，冬季能源保障压力继续上升。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 能源系统的韧性，不只看装机容量，也看受损后能否快速绕行和修复。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 冬天还没来，备用方案必须先到。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：乌克兰能源。

en-US.headlineFact: Ukrainian energy sites were hit 13 times in one week
en-US.headlineView: nearly 300 attacks this year bring winter supply risks forward
en-US.headlineFull: Ukrainian energy sites were hit 13 times in one week; nearly 300 attacks this year bring winter supply risks forward
en-US.intro: Ukraine's state energy company said drones and missiles struck facilities across several regions 13 times in a week, seriously damaging equipment and production capacity; attacks this year are approaching 300 as winter supply pressure grows.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Energy resilience is not only installed capacity; it is the ability to reroute and repair after damage.
en-US.doudouQuote: Winter has not arrived, but the backup plan must.

sources.title: Ukraine energy company says its facilities seriously damaged after 13 Russian strikes in a week

zh-CN.headlineFact: 刚果埃博拉死亡超过2300人创本国最严重纪录
zh-CN.headlineView: 病例追踪速度落后于Bundibugyo毒株扩散
zh-CN.headlineFull: 刚果埃博拉死亡超过2300人创本国最严重纪录；病例追踪速度落后于Bundibugyo毒株扩散
zh-CN.intro: 刚果东部六省的快速疫情已造成超过2300人死亡，最新24小时新增101例与33人死亡；超过1000人康复，730人仍在医院或隔离点，许多新病例不在既有监测名单内。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 当传播速度超过追踪速度，扩充一线人员就是最直接的数据工程。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 名单追不上病毒，队伍就必须跑得更快。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：刚果埃博拉。

en-US.headlineFact: Congo's Ebola death toll passed 2,300, its worst national outbreak
en-US.headlineView: contact tracing is falling behind the Bundibugyo strain
en-US.headlineFull: Congo's Ebola death toll passed 2,300, its worst national outbreak; contact tracing is falling behind the Bundibugyo strain
en-US.intro: The fast-moving outbreak across six eastern provinces has killed more than 2,300 people, with 101 new cases and 33 deaths in the latest 24 hours; over 1,000 recovered and 730 remain hospitalized or isolated, while many new cases are outside monitoring lists.
en-US.xiaziQuote: When transmission outruns tracing, scaling frontline staff becomes the most direct form of data engineering.
en-US.doudouQuote: If the list cannot catch the virus, the response team must move faster.

sources.title: Congo's fast-moving Ebola outbreak becomes the country's worst with over 2,300 dead

zh-CN.headlineFact: 暴雨与山洪风险从中西部移向中大西洋地区
zh-CN.headlineView: 既有高水位让新一轮降雨更易触发次生灾害
zh-CN.headlineFull: 暴雨与山洪风险从中西部移向中大西洋地区；既有高水位让新一轮降雨更易触发次生灾害
zh-CN.intro: 雷暴、强降雨与山洪继续威胁美国中西部至中大西洋地区；西弗吉尼亚、俄亥俄东南部和肯塔基东北部处于洪水监视，印第安纳此前风暴已造成7人死亡。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 同样一场雨，落在已经饱和的土地上，就是完全不同的风险等级。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 路障不是建议，积水也不是捷径。

en-US.headlineFact: Heavy rain and flash-flood risk shifted from the Midwest toward the mid-Atlantic
en-US.headlineView: already-high water makes another round more dangerous
en-US.headlineFull: Heavy rain and flash-flood risk shifted from the Midwest toward the mid-Atlantic; already-high water makes another round more dangerous
en-US.intro: Thunderstorms, heavy rain and flash flooding continued from the Midwest toward the mid-Atlantic; West Virginia, southeast Ohio and northeast Kentucky were under flood watches, while earlier storms in Indiana had killed seven people.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The same rain falling on saturated ground belongs to a completely different risk category.
en-US.doudouQuote: A barricade is not advice, and floodwater is not a shortcut.

sources.title: Flooding risk remains as storms move from the Midwest to the mid-Atlantic

zh-CN.headlineFact: Lala离开夏威夷后留下43.54英寸极端降雨
zh-CN.headlineView: 风险从强风转向清淤、道路与滑坡恢复
zh-CN.headlineFull: Lala离开夏威夷后留下43.54英寸极端降雨；风险从强风转向清淤、道路与滑坡恢复
zh-CN.intro: Lala减弱并西移后，夏威夷已无沿海警报，但危险海浪和离岸流仍存在；大岛Laupahoehoe记录到43.54英寸降雨，树木、电线、道路与住宅受损进入集中恢复期。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 风暴离开镜头之后，真正漫长的是把道路、电力和日常生活一项项接回来。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 风下班了，泥水还在加班。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：夏威夷风暴。

en-US.headlineFact: Lala left 43.54 inches of extreme rain after moving west of Hawaii
en-US.headlineView: risk has shifted from wind to mud, roads and landslide recovery
en-US.headlineFull: Lala left 43.54 inches of extreme rain after moving west of Hawaii; risk has shifted from wind to mud, roads and landslide recovery
en-US.intro: With Lala weakening and moving west, Hawaii had no coastal warnings, though dangerous surf and rip currents remained; Laupahoehoe on the Big Island recorded 43.54 inches of rain as communities began restoring roads, power and homes.
en-US.xiaziQuote: After the storm leaves the frame, the long work is reconnecting roads, power and daily life one piece at a time.
en-US.doudouQuote: The wind clocked out; the mud is still working overtime.

sources.title: Muddy cleanup ahead as Tropical Storm Lala moves west of Hawaii
